```{r}

# --- PREPARE DATA FOR ANALYSIS --- #

# Add baselines

baseline = ds_ecosystems %>%
  filter(time_point == time_point_of_baselines) %>%
  select(ecosystem_ID,
         all_of(response_variable_selected)) %>%
  rename(baseline = all_of(response_variable_selected))

data_for_analysis = ds_ecosystems %>%
  left_join(baseline)

# Filter and mutate

data_for_analysis = ds_ecosystems %>%
  filter(time_point >= first_time_point_model,
         time_point <= last_time_point_model,
         !is.na(!!sym(response_variable_selected))) %>%
  mutate(ecosystem_ID = as.character(ecosystem_ID),
         size = as.character(ecosystem_size_ml),
         conn = factor(x = ifelse(connection == "connected", 
                                  "con", 
                                  "unconnected"),
                       levels = c("unconnected", "con")))
```

```{r}

# --- CREATE MODEL --- #

# Prepare data

data_for_analysis = data_for_analysis %>% 
  rename(dis_per = disturbance_percentage)

# Construct model

if(response_variable_selected == "bioarea_mm2_per_ml"){

  model <- lme(fixed = log10_bioarea_mm2_per_ml ~ 
                           size * conn * dis_per * trophic_type,
                  random = ~ 1 | ecosystem_ID / system_nr,
                  weights = varIdent(form = ~ 1 | day * trophic_type * dis_per),
                  data = data_for_analysis,
                  control = lmeControl(opt = "nlminb", maxIter = 1000, msMaxIter = 1000, tolerance = 1e-6))
}

if(response_variable_selected == "shannon" | response_variable_selected == "evenness_pielou"){
 
  model = lmer(get(response_variable_selected) ~
               size * conn * dis_per +
               (1 | ecosystem_ID) +
               (1 | day),
   data = data_for_analysis,
   REML = FALSE,
   control = lmerControl(optimizer = "Nelder_Mead"))
  
}
```

<details open="open">
<summary>Model residuals</summary>
```{r fig.width = figures_height_rmd_output}

# --- PLOT MODEL RESIDUALS --- #

# Create Q-Q plots

qqnorm(resid(model))
qqline(resid(model))

# Create Res vs Fit plots - interactive

create.res.vs.fit.ecosystems(model,
                             data_for_analysis)

# Create Res vs Fit plots - non interactive

fitted_values <- fitted(model)
residuals_values <- resid(model)

plot(fitted_values, residuals_values,
     xlab = "Fitted Values",
     ylab = "Residuals",
     main = "Residuals vs. Fitted Values")

abline(h = 0, col = "red", lty = 2)

loess_fit <- loess(residuals_values ~ fitted_values)
lines(fitted_values[order(fitted_values)],
      predict(loess_fit)[order(fitted_values)],
      col = "blue",
      lwd = 2)

# Plot residuals spread by trophic type

data_for_analysis$residuals <- residuals(model)
data_for_analysis$fitted <- fitted(model)
ggplot(data_for_analysis, aes(x = factor(trophic_type), y = residuals)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  labs(x = "Trophic Type", y = "Residuals", title = "Residuals by Trophic Type")

# Plot residuals spread by connection

ggplot(data_for_analysis, aes(x = factor(connection), y = residuals)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  labs(x = "Connection", y = "Residuals", title = "Residuals by connection")

# Plot residuals spread by day

ggplot(data_for_analysis, aes(x = factor(day), y = residuals)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  labs(x = "Day", y = "Residuals", title = "Residuals by Day")

# Plot residuals spread by disturbance percentage

ggplot(data_for_analysis, aes(x = factor(dis_per), y = residuals)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  labs(x = "Disturbance percentage", y = "Residuals", title = "Residuals by disturbance percentage")
```
